title: House Painting Project Tutorial – freeCodeCamp Lab for Beginners in HTML & CSS
description:
House Painting Project Tutorial – freeCodeCamp Lab for Beginners in HTML & CSS

Introduction
The House Painting project is one of the official freeCodeCamp labs, designed to help beginners practice HTML and CSS by building a visually structured house layout. This project is perfect for those who want to learn how to use positioning, layout, and styling effectively while completing a hands-on coding exercise.

In this tutorial, you’ll learn step by step how to create a complete house with roof, chimney, windows, and door, and understand how each element is positioned within the house container. By following this guide, you’ll gain practical skills to build your own web projects confidently.
lab link: https://www.freecodecamp.org/learn/responsive-web-design-v9/lab-house-painting/build-a-house-painting
watch at Youtube: https://youtu.be/-b09x5Hjxd4

What You Will Learn

  • HTML Structure for the House:

    • How to create a container div for the house with id="house".

    • Adding five essential elements inside the house:

      • roof for the top of the house

      • chimney for a realistic effect

      • window-1 and window-2

      • door for the entrance

  • CSS Positioning Techniques:

    • Setting the house container to position: relative.

    • Positioning all child elements with position: absolute.

    • Correctly placing the roof at the top, the chimney behind the house, windows below the roof, and the door at the bottom.

  • Styling and Design:

    • Adding width, height, border, and background-color to all elements.

    • Creating a simple yet visually appealing house design using basic CSS styling.

    • Understanding the importance of z-index to layer elements properly.

  • Passing freeCodeCamp Lab Tests:

    • The project is structured to pass all required freeCodeCamp tests.

    • Ensures your HTML and CSS meet the exact criteria specified in the lab.

Why This Project is Great for Beginners

  • Hands-on experience with HTML and CSS basics.

  • Learn to structure elements logically within a container.

  • Understand relative vs absolute positioning clearly.

  • Practice following freeCodeCamp lab instructions to develop accuracy in coding.

  • Build a visual project that you can show as part of your portfolio.

Project Outcome

By the end of this project, you will have:

  • A fully functional house layout with a roof, chimney, windows, and door.

  • Clear understanding of positioning, sizing, and styling elements with CSS.

  • Confidence to tackle other freeCodeCamp labs and beginner projects.

  • A visually appealing project to practice and showcase your skills.

Keywords: freeCodeCamp labs, HTML tutorial for beginners, CSS positioning, house painting project, beginner web development projects, relative and absolute positioning, hands-on HTML CSS practice.
